record.body: Signature alarm vocabulary is an invented set of alarm calls that vary systematically with the threat: one call for a ground intruder, one for an aerial intruder, and modifiers that encode speed and size, so that a listener can reconstruct a description of the intruder from the call alone. The idea is borrowed from prairie dog alarm research, but every call shape and modifier in the Signature version is an original design, and the pair states the decoding rule explicitly so a reader can test it. This is a Signature design, never presented as field data. This record covers the Signature biophony layer, distinct from Signature geophony and Signature anthrophony.
